profile.headline: Software Engineer at CGI | Microsoft Certified Data Engineer
profile.summary:
Versatile Software Engineer Consultant with expertise in middleware solutions/cross-platform integrations, data structures like medallion architectures, and system migrations. 

Proven ability to design and develop scalable ETL/ELT processes using technologies like MuleSoft, Python, Dataform, and C#. Certified in Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, and Mulesoft. 

Beyond the code, I am a strong collaborator focused on acting as a bridge between the complex technical requirements and the business users, ensuring every data solution provides real business value.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Delivered middleware solutions for enterprise clients across the public sector, housing, and energy industries. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to modernize legacy systems, developed middleware applications, and ensured seamless data flow between critical applications.

Key Projects:

Data Platform and Governance
Architected a scalable Medallion Architecture in BigQuery using Dataform, establishing enterprise governance through BigQuery taxonomies and developed serverless utilities using Python and Cloud Functions, orchestrated ELT pipelines with Airflow and Airbyte.
Technologies: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Airbyte, Airflow, BigQuery, Dataform, Python, Cloud Functions, SQL
Role: Lead Data Engineer

General Ledger Migration to SAP
Gathered requirements, designed and developed MuleSoft middleware to extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from boundary systems into SAP. 
Technologies: MuleSoft, SAP Connector, SQL
Roles: Jr. Technical Lead, Software Engineer

TIBCO to MuleSoft Middleware Modernization 
Developed integrations in the third wave of a multi-phase migration, replacing TIBCO with MuleSoft. Implemented discovery, design, and development of MuleSoft applications for enterprise data. 
Technologies: MuleSoft, TIBCO, SQL
Role: Software Engineer

Applied Epic Modernization
Integrated legacy iSeries applications with Applied Epic using C# and MVC. Enabled seamless data synchronization. 
Technologies: C#, .Net, MVC, iSeries, SQL
Role: Software Engineer
